title: Starts Monday Aug 24, 2026 —
body: the start of the trading week the reset happened in, one day earlier than where IBKR's own performance tracking (get_pa_performance_all_periods) begins (Aug 25). Aug 24 checked clean — no write-off pattern, real trades, +$2,916 that day.

title: Found and removed: a reset write-off, not real trades.
body: At exactly 2026-08-26 00:00 (a single synthetic timestamp), CRM, MSTR (×2 lots), NU (×2 lots), NVDA (×2 lots) and OKLO were all written off at price $0 against positions that were genuinely open — the same artefact weekly-trades already documented for the prior week (CRM/NU/NVDA that time too). Checked the entire dataset for any other multi-symbol same-timestamp batch: this is the only one. That alone was −$10,798.

title: Found and removed: an IBIT position carried in from before the window.
body: The IBIT exits on 2026-08-25 traced their cost basis back to lots opened Aug 21 and Aug 24 — a real trade, but one whose entry predates the week being measured, so it isn't this week's decision to take credit or blame for. Dropped (−$3,859 removed from the curve, mirroring weekly-trades' --drop-carry).

title: Net vs. gross:
body: commission on this window ($3,384.67) is bigger than the net result — before commission the same trades made more. Both lines are on the chart below; the gap between them at any point is exactly the cumulative commission to date.
